title: Magazine p. 61: Skylab sunrise mistaken for UFO (NASA photo SL3-118-2177)
description: Photocopied magazine page of article text with a dark, mostly featureless photograph (numbered 36) captioned "A common source of space and other UFOs is shown here. The aura and the lens-shaped disc is actually a sunrise photographed from Skylab. NASA photo SL3-118-2177." The text quotes astronauts including Gordon, Grissom, Young, Slayton, Aldrin and Bean denying UFO sightings, with a handwritten "Apollo 12" annotation.
